Abdulelah Al-Amri.note: Al-Amri already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Uruguay. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Abdulelah Al-Amri.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Abdullah Al-Hamdan.note: Al-Hamdan gives Saudi Arabia a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Abdullah Al-Hamdan.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Abdullah Al-Khaibari.note: Al-Khaibari has been one of Saudi Arabia's midfield connectors in this tournament. He keeps the next pass alive and helps the team avoid rushed choices.
Abdullah Al-Khaibari.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia让控球不散掉的球员之一。看点是他多早就知道下一脚传给谁。

Ahmed Al-Kassar.summary: Ahmed Al-Kassar is a Saudi Arabia goalkeeper from Al-Qadsiah who brings experience, reaction saves, and penalty-area control.
Ahmed Al-Kassar.note: Al-Kassar is Saudi Arabia's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Ahmed Al-Kassar.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Alaa Hejji.summary: Alaa Hejji is a Saudi Arabia central midfielder from NEOM SC who helps connect possession and support counter-pressing phases.
Alaa Hejji.note: Hejji gives Saudi Arabia a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Alaa Hejji.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Ali Lajami.note: Lajami is defensive cover for Saudi Arabia's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Ali Lajami.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Ali Majrashi.note: Majrashi is part of Saudi Arabia's tournament depth. His card is about making the simple play feel available under pressure.
Ali Majrashi.noteZh: 他在Saudi Arabia的赛事角色建立在干净决策上。看他的第一脚触球，是让球队稳下来，还是让下一次进攻加速。

Ayman Yahya.note: Yahya gives Saudi Arabia cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Ayman Yahya.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Firas Al-Buraikan.note: Al-Buraikan is one of Saudi Arabia's named attacking routes in this tournament. His job is to make the first defender move so the finish or final pass can appear.
Firas Al-Buraikan.noteZh: 他给Saudi Arabia一种把控球变成压力的路线。他要让防守者必须做选择。

Hassan Al-Tambakti.note: Al-Tambakti gives Saudi Arabia one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Hassan Al-Tambakti.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Hassan Kadesh.summary: Hassan Kadesh is a Saudi Arabia left-back from Al-Ittihad who gives the team left-footed balance, defensive experience, and set-piece presence.
Hassan Kadesh.note: Kadesh gives Saudi Arabia cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Hassan Kadesh.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Jehad Thakri.summary: Jehad Thakri is a Saudi Arabia centre-back from Al-Qadsiah who adds size, aerial defending, and squad depth.
Jehad Thakri.note: Thakri is the kind of defender Saudi Arabia can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Jehad Thakri.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Khalid Al-Ghannam.note: Al-Ghannam is attacking depth for Saudi Arabia. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Khalid Al-Ghannam.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Mohamed Kanno.note: Kanno is midfield insurance for Saudi Arabia. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Mohamed Kanno.noteZh: 他给Saudi Arabia一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.summary: Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat is a Saudi Arabia right-back from Al-Qadsiah who offers recovery speed, overlap timing, and defensive energy.
Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.note: Al-Shamat gives Saudi Arabia cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Mohammed Al-Owais.note: Al-Owais is the last voice in Saudi Arabia's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Mohammed Al-Owais.noteZh: 他承担了Saudi Arabia的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Moteb Al-Harbi.summary: Moteb Al-Harbi is a Saudi Arabia left-back from Al-Hilal who brings overlap timing, recovery defending, and left-footed service.
Moteb Al-Harbi.note: Al-Harbi is defensive rotation for Saudi Arabia. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Moteb Al-Harbi.noteZh: 他给Saudi Arabia那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Musab Al-Juwayr.note: Al-Juwayr is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Saudi Arabia, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Musab Al-Juwayr.noteZh: 他给Saudi Arabia提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Nasser Al-Dawsari.summary: Nasser Al-Dawsari is a Saudi Arabia central midfielder from Al-Hilal who adds coverage, passing discipline, and late shooting threat.
Nasser Al-Dawsari.note: Al-Dawsari gives Saudi Arabia a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Nasser Al-Dawsari.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Nawaf Al-Aqidi.note: Al-Aqidi is goalkeeper cover for Saudi Arabia. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Nawaf Al-Aqidi.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Nawaf Boushal.summary: Nawaf Boushal is a Saudi Arabia right-back from Al-Nassr who brings overlap energy, recovery speed, and wide defensive bite.
Nawaf Boushal.note: Boushal is back-line insurance for Saudi Arabia. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Nawaf Boushal.noteZh: 他给Saudi Arabia那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Saleh Al-Shehri.note: Al-Shehri gives Saudi Arabia a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Saleh Al-Shehri.noteZh: 他是Saudi Arabia在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Salem Al-Dawsari.note: Al-Dawsari is one of Saudi Arabia's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Salem Al-Dawsari.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对Saudi Arabia来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Saud Abdulhamid.note: Abdulhamid has been part of Saudi Arabia's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Saud Abdulhamid.noteZh: 他给Saudi Arabia后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Sultan Mandash.note: Mandash is the forward Saudi Arabia can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Sultan Mandash.noteZh: 他给Saudi Arabia替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Ziyad Al-Johani.summary: Ziyad Al-Johani is a Saudi Arabia defensive midfielder from Al-Ahli who adds ball winning, central coverage, and short progression.
Ziyad Al-Johani.note: Al-Johani is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Saudi Arabia, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Ziyad Al-Johani.noteZh: 他给Saudi Arabia提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。
